400.label: Bad request
400.title: That order made no sense
400.text: Our barista could not read that request. Go back and try again from the start.

401.label: Please sign in
401.title: Hold on, who is there?
401.text: You need to sign in before we can serve you. Pop your name and password in at the counter.

403.label: No access
403.title: Staff only: kitchen door
403.text: This area is for a different part of the crew. If you think you should have a key, ask a manager.

404.label: Page not found
404.title: Oops! This table is empty
404.text: We checked under the counter, behind the espresso machine and inside the biscuit jar. The page you wanted is not here.

405.label: Method not allowed
405.title: Wrong way to order
405.text: That kind of request is not on our menu. Try opening the page from the app instead.

408.label: Request timed out
408.title: The coffee went cold waiting
408.text: The connection took too long. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.

413.label: Request too large
413.title: That is too big for our tray
413.text: What you sent is larger than we can carry. Try something smaller.

414.label: Address too long
414.title: That address is longer than our bill
414.text: The link is far too long. Go back to the start and open it from there.

429.label: Too many requests
429.title: Whoa, easy there, speedy!
429.text: Too many requests in a short time. Take a sip, wait a minute, then try again.

500.label: Something went wrong
500.title: Our kitchen had a little spill
500.text: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell the manager.

502.label: Server is not answering
502.title: The coffee machine is warming up
502.text: The server is starting up or restarting. This page tries again by itself every 15 seconds.

503.label: Temporarily unavailable
503.title: Back in a moment
503.text: The cafe is catching its breath. This page tries again by itself every 15 seconds.

504.label: Server too slow
504.title: The order is taking forever
504.text: The server took too long to answer. This page tries again by itself every 15 seconds.

crash.label: Screen problem
crash.title: Oops, something spilled
crash.text: This screen hit a problem. Anything you already saved is safe on the server. Reload to carry on.
